clause_descriptions.Indemnification: A clause requiring one party to compensate the other for losses or damages
clause_descriptions.Limitation of Liability: A clause that caps or limits one party's liability exposure
clause_descriptions.Uncapped Liability: No maximum limit on potential damages — extremely dangerous
clause_descriptions.IP Ownership Assignment: Transfers intellectual property rights from one party to another
clause_descriptions.Non-Compete: Restricts a party from competing in similar business activities
clause_descriptions.Exclusivity: Grants exclusive rights, preventing engagement with competitors
clause_descriptions.Most Favored Nation: Guarantees terms at least as favorable as those given to others
clause_descriptions.Anti-Assignment: Prevents transfer of contract rights to third parties
clause_descriptions.Change of Control: Triggers rights/obligations upon ownership or management changes
clause_descriptions.Liquidated Damages: Pre-determined damage amounts for specific breach scenarios
clause_descriptions.Termination For Convenience: Allows termination without cause or specific reason
clause_descriptions.Non-Solicitation: Prevents hiring or soliciting the other party's employees
clause_descriptions.Minimum Commitment: Requires a minimum purchase, usage, or investment level
clause_descriptions.Volume Restriction: Limits on transaction or production volumes
clause_descriptions.Post-Termination Services: Obligations that continue after contract termination
clause_descriptions.Audit Rights: Rights to inspect or audit the other party's records
clause_descriptions.Governing Law: Specifies which jurisdiction's laws govern the contract
clause_descriptions.Jurisdiction: Determines where legal disputes will be resolved
clause_descriptions.Warranty Duration: Time period during which warranties remain effective
clause_descriptions.Notice Period: Required advance notice before taking certain actions
clause_descriptions.Renewal Term: Conditions and duration for contract renewal
